operations.title: Benincasa closes the base total-energy/Cut corner
operations.body: Entry 1148 is complete, event ev-000000000868-0a9bc0a0-103f-4052-bf10-16bd41970de5. Since q_G12=E_T+y12, (E_T,y12)->(E_T,q_G12) is unimodular with determinant one. The nearby and Cut divisors are transverse, have no excess Tor or mod-two carrier defect, and their residue square differs only by the standard Koszul sign. Therefore Entry 1147's Z/2 cusp coinvariant cannot be activated by base incidence failure. The remaining exact gate is the positive Cayley-Menger/signed-minor/Leray relative-chain comparison at E_T=y12=0.
